dogecoin.text: This same descending triangle was also seen before the $DOGE price had risen from less than $0.003 to over $0.7 in a matter of months. if #Dogecoin were to go on a similar rally, then the price of the meme coin could rise as high as $10.

#Dogecoin price started a strong increase from the $0.080 support zone.
$DOGE cleared many hurdles near $0.0850 to enter a positive zone. Dogecoin is up over 25% against the #US Dollar. DOGE cleared the $0.120 resistance and might continue to rise toward the $0.132 resistance.

Now ranked tenth among the world's largest cryptocurrencies, #Dogecoin has a market cap of $15.7 billion. It has even surpassed #Avalanche in value. Its impressive performance, coupled with the positive outlook of traders, underscores $Doge potential for further growth.

#Dogecoin broke past key resistance levels, and if it maintains this momentum, the next target could be the barrier at the $0.15 mark.
The support level to watch is now around $0.10, with further safety at the $0.09 level, where the
50-day moving average currently sits.
